results.name: Initial state has editable fields, a gray disabled save and no edit/cancel controls
Each field and combined reversions compare actual values with the saved baseline
Cancel preserves input; confirmed save refreshes the service view and resets the baseline
Discarded items lock every status field and save, including direct handler calls
Existing approval validation still runs before the save confirmation
Set-wide state propagation and warning are preserved after the new save flow
Navigation warns only while values differ, and stops warning after a full reversion
Question pauses work; answer persists, resumes the same request and stays visible in the main card
A replaced file snapshot retries with a fresh handle and recovers without flashing an English warning
A result prompts manual reload, stays visible when the panel closes, and preserves the result after reload
Status controls and save remain usable at 390px
